# @trysac/status-workflow

> Typed configurable state machine for business statuses with guards, immutable audit history, optimistic versioning and Mermaid export. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. No runtime dependencies. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and API
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files and how coverage works
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
